item.title: AI is making junior devs useless
Why XML Tags Are So Fundamental to Claude
Ape Coding
item.description:
📝 Ape coding is a software development practice where a human developer deliberately hand-writes source code. Advocacy for human-written software Ape coding advocates argued that a return to human-written software would resolve the issues introduced by AI software development. Ape coders manifest high levels of engagement during coding sessions and report feelings of relaxation after succeeding in (self-imposed) coding challenges.
🔗 Read more: https://rsaksida.com/blog/ape-coding/
